import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class C421 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = scanner.nextInt();
        int b = scanner.nextInt();
        int l = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        int r = scanner.nextInt() - 1;       
        int ans;
        int len = a + b;
        int dif = r - l;
        if(dif >= 2 * len) {
            ans = Math.max(a + 1, 2 * a - b);
        } else {
            r -= len * (l / len);
            l %= len;
            ans = countDifferentLetters(a, b, l, r);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
    
    static int countDifferentLetters(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
        int first = b < a ? b : a - 1;
        int last = a - 1;
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        char ch = 'a';
        for(int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            sb.append(ch);
            ch++;
        }
        ch = l < a ? sb.charAt(last) : sb.charAt(first);
        for(int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
            sb.append(ch);
        }
        boolean[] used = new boolean[30];
        for(int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            used[sb.charAt(sb.length() - i - 1) - 'a'] = true;
        }
        int ptr = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            while(used[ptr]) ptr++;
            sb.append((char)('a' + ptr));
            used[ptr] = true;
        }
        ch = sb.charAt(Math.min(b, a - 1) + a + b);
        for(int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
            sb.append(ch);
        }
        for(int i = 0; i < a + b; ++i) {
            sb.append(sb.charAt(i));
        }
        return countUniqueLetters(sb.toString(), l, r);
    }
    
    static int countUniqueLetters(String s, int l, int r) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[30];
        for(int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
            used[s.charAt(i) - 'a'] = true;
        }
        int count = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i < 30; ++i) {
            if(used[i]) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }
}
